decision: Owner-approved outcome-first revision 2026-11-25; final EF02 closure, no additional routine EF02 PR.
scope: All 194 original roots (190 retained root paths plus 4 relocated UI paths). Owner evidence is pinned literal/text census, not proof of unused code. Consumer changes are reconciled to current blob IDs; docs/test/QA mentions are not all live imports. Non-root transitive dependencies follow their owning subsystem, subject to fresh consumer review before deletion.

build.action: Consolidate current boot, version, entry and CSS with reproducible production/QA build; preserve public and comparison URLs until verified migration.
build.gate: Pinned Vite/npm/Three and reproducible Pages build, CSS cascade and runtime parity, link and cache tests.

engine.action: Keep current/reusable behavior and retained adapters until final engine ownership and generic replacement are implemented; consolidate or retire superseded implementations in same subsystem outcome.
engine.gate: Current fixed-120Hz, input, track/flight/GRIP/jump/trick/landing, boost, camera, race/PB/storage and generic synthetic fixture parity, as applicable; Skyline/Aurora remain until EF04/05.

environment.action: Keep until final shared environment/ship/material implementation and corresponding consumer migration; remove obsolete version/installer chains and exclusive old track assets only with proven replacement.
environment.gate: Real Vault High/4GB WebGL and independent track sampler parity; preserve wave, straight edge, reflections, ship/road/rail lighting; EF04/05 gates before Skyline/Aurora retirement.

lifecycle.action: Resolve resource-loading and initialization ownership during actual lifecycle replacement; remove superseded loader paths only with verified asset and lifetime contracts.
lifecycle.gate: Cold/warm startup, asset resolution, repeat load/teardown/cache/dispose/context recovery parity and resource stability.

qa.action: Review retained historical QA/tool/source-path contracts after upstream subsystem replacements; retain unresolved/unique behavior until equivalent executable coverage, then retire exclusive old source and shims together.
qa.gate: Current functional/visual/physics/Pages coverage, exact dependency closure, measured CI and final root/layout acceptance.

intentional.action: Retain root entry/documentation only if intentionally necessary; verify at final layout acceptance, not automatic exception.
intentional.gate: Final <=10 intentional root files with genuine documented exceptions, no obsolete standalone root artifacts.

literalGraph.ef01Method: EF01 heuristic (different scanner; not directly comparable)
